entries.answer: The Department of Revenue business license page does not list documents to upload. What it does say to have ready: your Secretary of State filing done first if your business is a Washington corporation, partnership, LLC or LLP; a business name if you will use one other than your full legal name; and a My DOR online account to apply online. You do not need a UBI number to apply. You get one after licensing. For a mail-in application you send the Business License Application, any additional forms, and payment. The page does not mention an EIN or other ID numbers, so check with the agency.

links.label: DOR: Apply for a business license

entries.answer: The Department of Revenue says excise tax returns (sales tax and B&O) are due on a schedule that depends on your filing frequency. Monthly returns are due the 25th of the following month. Quarterly returns are due the end of the month after the quarter, for example April 30 for January to March. Annual returns are due April 15. If a due date falls on a weekend or holiday it moves to the next business day. DOR assigns your frequency from your estimated yearly income, and it is in the welcome letter after you register. To change it, DOR lists 360-705-6705. Always confirm your own dates with DOR.

links.label: DOR: Filing frequencies and due dates

entries.answer: The Department of Revenue says you do not need a UBI number to apply for a business license. You receive a Unified Business Identifier after you are licensed. It is unique to your business, and you will need it for tax filings and changes.
